# EMUSKI

> EMUSKI is an India-based turnkey precision engineering and contract manufacturing company specializing in CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, sub-assemblies, and cost engineering (VAVE and should-cost analysis) for global OEMs.

Headquartered with manufacturing facilities in Bangalore, India, EMUSKI serves aerospace, automotive, industrial automation, and medical equipment OEMs. EMUSKI operates as a full-stack manufacturing and export partner, handling raw material sourcing, multi-axis machining, surface treatment, quality inspection (CMM), and global logistics.

## Core Manufacturing & Engineering Services

- [Precision Manufacturing Services](https://www.emuski.com/manufacturing-services): Overview of CNC turning, 3-axis/4-axis/5-axis milling, sheet metal fabrication, and contract manufacturing capabilities in Bangalore, India.
- [Cost Engineering & Should-Cost Services](https://www.emuski.com/cost-engineering-services): Bottom-up should-cost modeling, teardown analysis, and Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) achieving 15–25% Bill of Materials (BOM) cost reduction.
- [Contract Manufacturing India](https://www.emuski.com/): Turnkey build-to-print mechanical and electromechanical assembly services for international procurement heads and supply chain teams.

## Key Technical Resources & Guides

- [Should-Cost Analysis Guide](https://www.emuski.com/blog/should-cost-analysis-the-engineer-s-guide-to-accurate-product-cost-estimation): Technical guide to bottom-up cost breakdown, machine hourly rates, and manufacturing cost modeling.
- [Lean Manufacturing & Waste Elimination](https://www.emuski.com/blog/lean-manufacturing-the-complete-guide-to-eliminating-waste-and-maximizing-efficiency): Practical framework on cycle-time reduction, takt time optimization, and shop-floor productivity in precision machining.
- [OEM Strategic Sourcing in India](https://www.emuski.com/blog/strategic-sourcing-for-oem-manufacturers-how-india-s-supplier-ecosystem-compares-to-china-for-precision-parts): Analysis of India's manufacturing supplier base, export logistics, and quality compliance for US/EU sourcing directors.
- [How to Choose a Precision Machining Partner in India](https://www.emuski.com/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-manufacturing-partner-in-india-precision-machining-for-robotics-aerospace): Evaluation matrix covering machine capabilities, GD&T inspection, certifications, and IP protection.

## Geographic Capabilities & Regional Hubs

- [Bangalore Precision Manufacturing Hub](https://www.emuski.com/manufacturing-services): Details on Bangalore facility infrastructure, CMM inspection, and export logistics through Chennai and Mumbai ports.
- [Cost Engineering UK & Europe](https://www.emuski.com/cost-engineering-uk): Engineering consultancy and supplier benchmarking services tailored to UK and European manufacturing standards.
